categories_thin: Hardware / appliance retail: the only hardware stores near Monroe are in Jamesburg borough (Better Living Hardware, Jamesburg Hardware & Appliance) or chains (Tractor Supply); no independent hardware store found inside the township.
Music store / bookstore: only national chains (Guitar Center, Music & Arts, Barnes & Noble) returned for Monroe.
Hotels: only chain properties (DoubleTree, Hyatt House, Travelers Inn in Dayton) were returned; no independent hotel found.
Event venues: few independent venues - Forsgate Country Club is the main private one; township banquet space is municipal/HOA-run.
Toy, hobby and book retail is essentially absent; most gift-type shops are florists/nurseries.
Independent pharmacies, food shops and restaurants were out of scope for group D and excluded.
caveats: Jamesburg borough shares ZIP 08831 and sits inside the 10-mile radius but is a separate municipality, so Jamesburg-address businesses were excluded. Examples seen: Better Living Hardware (77 E Railroad Ave), Jamesburg Hardware & Appliance (231 Gatzmer Ave), Sweet William & Thyme florist (19 E Railroad Ave), Lester Memorial Home (16 W Church St), The Artisan Framer (14 W Railroad Ave), Jamesburg Press/Madison Printing, Thompson Bark, Mozarts and Einsteins Preschool (175 Gatzmer Ave).

National/regional chains and franchises were excluded: Childtime, Kiddie Academy, The Goddard School, Kumon, Mathnasium, Best Brains, JEI, School of Rock, Crown Trophy, FASTSIGNS, Mr. Appliance, Club Z!, U-Haul, Costco/Wakefern/Barnes & Noble/Williams-Sonoma distribution centers, Canon, Berry Global, Cargotec, Mitsubishi Electric, DMG Mori, Bracco, Invacare, TW Metals, Tricorbraun, The Children's Place DC.
Many entries come from bulk business directories only (marked 'one bulk directory only'); these may be dormant, home-based or renamed and need triage confirmation.
Google Maps in a signed-out browser shows a limited result set per query, so very small or unclaimed businesses may be missing.
Some listed addresses sit on municipal lines (Public Rd, Mounts Mills Rd, Renaissance Rd) - municipality should be confirmed during triage.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable (timeouts), so OSM data was not used.
Yellowpages.com, Cylex, Opendi, ChamberofCommerce.com and WhereOrg returned HTTP 403 to direct fetches; only search snippets were usable.
Monroe Township's own website has no searchable business directory; only an old 'What's Open' PDF was indexed.
Phone numbers for several small/home-based businesses were not published and are marked Unknown.
Southern Monroe Township below roughly latitude 40.305 (far Federal Rd / Englishtown Rd) falls outside the 10-mile radius and was only partially checked.
